label: Arabic machine (@zalavip-AR)
gate: repository variable ARABIC_LIVE=1 (the owner's word); until then the clock never starts this machine

checklist: pick the next Arabic topic with no script yet (arabic_id=auto) or the one given
facts from open sources, each with its source link; no number or date without a source
pictures from the shared library on R2 (read only): the same story, the same checked pictures
script in Egyptian Arabic following the Arabic style guide, not a word-for-word translation
hook: first 3 s of a short / first 15 s of a long is a question or a mystery; no logo, no intro
story check: after the hook, calm documented narration, no hype
audience cue plan (subscribe / follow / like) from media/brand/cta/ar.json, mirrored right to left
voice plan: Lahajati audio made by Antigravity; Gemini voice only for the preview

keys._note: The Meta system user is shared; the owner assigns the Zalavip-AR page and @zalavip_ar to it. Until GEMINI_API_KEY_AR exists the Arabic machine borrows the shared Gemini keys (workflow fallback).
